authority: none yet. Plan B2: 'Needs Arnav: yes, for the install and the round.' Every round budget (pHRR, CR, FIGRA, LOI) is spent; TTI is parked.
banned_moves_note: No new features and no thermal-property join: every candidate uses exactly its incumbent's feature matrix (pHRR's log_kpc is already an exp043/exp074 feature).
No row, material or paper is excluded or added: scoring rows are the incumbents' rows exactly.
No change to the Char Residue definition (cone residue, exp033 lineage); no STA-residue target.
FIGRA is never compared with 0.9724; THR is not touched.
Selection is by repeated-GKF mean, never by CI; adoption is under adoption_gate_v2.json (declared before any score, D1), not a rule changed after seeing results.

Not re-tuning: TabPFN runs at package defaults of one pinned version; Duan smearing has no free parameter; smearing is applied only to the pHRR and FIGRA records (never to TTI b2, which the findings list as banned re-tuning, and never to the TabPFN members). No clipping of CR predictions (clipping exp117 was already seen: 0.6505 / 0.6483).
Round budgets are spent, so this round runs only on Arnav's D3 word (exit rule: no round without a committed config and a human go).

smearing (B3; one candidate each for pHR.reference: Duan 1983, JASA 78:605 (smearing estimate), with the residuals taken out-of-fold inside each outer training fold (finding models-log-smearing) because tree members' in-sample log residuals are shrunk.
algorithm: M = the record model on the log1p scale (pHRR: hgb(); FIGRA: Avg([hgb, et(), ridge()]) as in step1).
for r in 0..9: for (tr, te) in GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=r).split(X, y, g) (the identical outer splits eval_protocol.repeated_group_kfold makes):
z = log1p(y[tr]); m = clone(M).fit(X[tr], z)  # identical to the incumbent's fold model
inner = empty(len(tr)); for (a, b) in GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=0).split(X[tr], z, g[tr]): inner[b] = clone(M).fit(X[tr][a], z[a]).predict(X[tr][b])
s = mean(exp(z - inner))  # arithmetic mean over all outer-training rows, unweighted; s is NOT clipped and may be < 1 because inner-OOF residuals need not average 0
smearing (B3; one candidate each for pHR.groups: the inner split uses the same group array as the outer split of that protocol (merged material groups for the primary protocol; category for pHRR's report-only category-GKF).
smearing (B3; one candidate each for pHR.consistency_check: per fold, (oof_s1 + 1) / s must equal the incumbent's oof + 1 to relative 1e-9 (same outer model); else BLOCKED for that target.
smearing (B3; one candidate each for pHR.reported: per target: the 50 primary-protocol fold factors s (mean, min, max, share < 1) in the s1 result JSON.
